intro: The Ewa bookshelf blends functionality with aesthetic charm. It offers a structured space to display your books and décor while keeping your home effortlessly organised and inviting, and truly yours.

features.title: A geometric shape for a warm, earthy feel
features.text: Its balanced geometric structure exudes warmth and harmony, adding a touch of natural elegance to any space.

features.title: Open shelves for easy accessibility for display
features.text: Thoughtfully designed open shelves provide seamless accessibility, making it easy to showcase books, keepsakes, and decorative pieces.

features.title: Four-tier display for ample storage
features.text: With four spacious levels, this bookshelf accommodates everything from novels to statement décor, ensuring clutter-free organization.

features.title: Sturdy construction for long-lasting durability
features.text: Crafted from engineered wood, its robust structure promises strength and stability, making it a reliable addition to your home.

features.title: Vertical Design to maximize floor space
features.text: Designed for efficiency, its tall and slim build optimizes room space while adding a striking visual appeal to your interiors.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
